% Water cold-plate resistance against flow rate (Fig. 4.4).
% Data: figures/data/rcp_*.dat, generated by figures/data/make_rcp_data.py.
% Laminar below Re = 2300 (14.45 mL/s), turbulent from Re = 4000 (25.13 mL/s);
% the flow meter's range starts at 1 L/min (16.67 mL/s).
% Include with: \input{figures/water_rcp}  (inside a figure environment)
\definecolor{watorange}{HTML}{EB6834}
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[
    width=0.75\linewidth, height=0.45\linewidth,
    xmin=5, xmax=75, ymin=0, ymax=0.12,
    xlabel={Water flow rate (\si{\milli\litre\per\second})},
    ylabel={$\Rcp$ (\si{\celsius\per\watt})},
    grid=major, major grid style={draw=black!12},
    axis lines*=left,
    scaled y ticks=false,
    yticklabel style={/pgf/number format/fixed, /pgf/number format/precision=2},
    tick label style={font=\footnotesize},
    label style={font=\small},
    legend style={draw=none, fill=white, fill opacity=0.85, text opacity=1,
      font=\footnotesize, at={(0.98,0.98)}, anchor=north east},
    legend cell align=left,
  ]
  % transitional range (no estimate) and lower limit of the flow meter
  \fill[black!8] (axis cs:14.45,0) rectangle (axis cs:25.13,0.12);
  \draw[black!50, densely dotted] (axis cs:16.67,0) -- (axis cs:16.67,0.12);
  \node[font=\scriptsize, text=black!60, align=center, anchor=north]
    at (axis cs:19.8,0.118) {transition\\$2300 < \mathrm{Re} < 4000$\\(no estimate)};
  \node[font=\scriptsize, text=black!60, anchor=north] at (axis cs:10,0.118) {laminar};
  \node[font=\scriptsize, text=black!60, anchor=north] at (axis cs:30,0.118) {turbulent};
  \node[font=\scriptsize, text=black!60, rotate=90, anchor=south west]
    at (axis cs:16.67,0.004) {meter range};

  \addplot[watorange, thick, forget plot] table[x=v, y=rcp] {figures/data/rcp_model_water_lam.dat};
  \addplot[watorange, thick] table[x=v, y=rcp] {figures/data/rcp_model_water_turb.dat};
  \addlegendentry{$\varepsilon$--NTU model}
  \addplot[black!60, thin] table[x=v, y=rcp] {figures/data/rcp_ats_fit.dat};
  \addlegendentry{ATS datasheet fit}
  \addplot[black!60, thin, dashed] table[x=v, y=rcp] {figures/data/rcp_ats_extrap.dat};
  \addlegendentry{ATS fit, extrapolated}
  \addplot[black!60, only marks, mark=square*, mark size=1.6pt]
    table[x=v, y=rcp] {figures/data/rcp_ats_points.dat};
  \addlegendentry{ATS datasheet points}
  \addplot[watorange, only marks, mark=diamond, mark size=3.5pt, thick,
    error bars/.cd, y dir=both, y explicit,
    error bar style={watorange, line width=0.6pt}, error mark options={rotate=90, mark size=2pt, watorange}]
    table[x=v, y=rcp, y error=u_rcp] {figures/data/rcp_meas_water.dat};
  \addlegendentry{Measured}
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
